policy.conflict: CONFLICT_FREEZE, even if a numerical posterior is high

limitations: Root identity and source independence are declared, not externally authenticated
Likelihood calculation assumes conditional independence across accepted roots, not established in real deployment
Calibration values are synthetic and not empirical measurements
High confidence alone cannot graduate evidence
First accepted packet per root is retained; production should preserve and flag equivocation from the same root
